entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the network to release a PDU session or the user-plane resources on a single access of an MA PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: A data session established between the UE and the network for data transmission.

entities.name: MA PDU session
entities.description: A multi-access PDU session that can use multiple access technologies simultaneously.

entities.name: User-plane resources
entities.description: Resources allocated for data transmission in the user plane of a PDU session.

relations.description: The procedure releases a PDU session.
The procedure releases user-plane resources on a single access of an MA PDU session.
An MA PDU session contains user-plane resources that can be released on a single access.
